evaluation.note: QLIKE and MSE on variance (Patton 2011); MSE x1e4. DM: Diebold-Mariano with Newey-West at the horizon and the Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold correction; negative favours the row model. |DM| >= 3 is the bar this repo uses.

rough.note: H from the q-moment scaling of log vol (Gatheral, Jaisson & Rosenbaum 2018). On five-minute realised vol they find ~0.1. log VIX is smoothed and reads high; a one-day range estimate is noisy and reads low. SPY's true roughness sits between.

mfiv.note: Chain truncated to +/-20% of spot and >= 5 days; the tails the VIX integrates are cut, so this reads a little under the published VIX. Compared against the last VIX close, which may be a day older.

caveat: Every number here is computed from daily SPY bars (FMP via macro.db), FRED's VIX and VIX3M, and the latest option snapshot. The forecast race is out of sample from 2010 with parameters refit monthly; the roughness estimates are bounds, not the intraday measure the literature uses.
